clue.text: Head for cover? On the contrary

definitions.text: Head for cover? On the contrary

parts.words: Head for cover? On the contrary
parts.note: turn the phrase round: not a head making for shelter but a cover for the head, the flat square cap worn at graduations

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to run for shelter, and is told the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head for cover' reads as a call to take shelter; 'On the contrary' tells you to swap it to a cover for the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A square academic cap with a tassel is literally a covering worn on the head.

clue.text: Savages consequently brought up on Sabbath

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, consequently

explanation.surface: Savages, as a result, raised on the Sabbath.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogres are brutish man-eating giants, so cruel savages.

clue.text: Spadeful overturned burying pot plants

indicators.note: the turned word buries, holds inside, the pot
overturned means the spade word is turned back to front

parts.note: a spit is the depth or amount of one spade's dig
an urn is a pot or vase

explanation.surface: A gardener's spadeful turned over buries some potted plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Turnips are root vegetables, cultivated garden plants of the cabbage family.

clue.text: Having taken drugs to get muscular

explanation.surface: A bodybuilder on steroids to bulk up.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang word covers both being stoned and having a toned, sculpted physique.

clue.text: Dover's easily engulfing Calais perhaps

indicators.note: the words engulf, holding within them, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: Dover easily swallows Calais, the port across the Channel.
explanation.walkthrough: Dover is the English Channel port facing Calais in France.
explanation.definitionFit: From Britain, the French port is abroad, across the sea, so it is an example of a foreign place.

clue.text: Let back into American university supporting study

indicators.note: in a down clue the university goes beneath, supporting, the study word

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: An American university readmits a student to support their study.
explanation.definitionFit: To readmit is to allow in again, letting someone return.

clue.text: About capable of grasping, grasping bottle opener? Disgraceful!

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: the second grasping means holding the next piece inside

parts.note: prehensile describes a tail or hand able to grip

indicators.note: the bottle opener is its first letter

explanation.surface: A monkey's tail grabs a bottle opener, and someone is outraged.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprehensible conduct deserves blame or censure, so it is shameful.

clue.text: Go off in French city turning more passionate

indicators.note: turning means the whole combination is read backwards
the decay word goes in the city

parts.note: Reims is a city in Champagne
to rot is to go off, to decay

explanation.surface: Something goes off in a French city as tempers get hotter.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormier means more tempestuous, so more fiery and passionate.

clue.text: Scoring over limit around box, right

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

indicators.note: the limit word goes around the next pieces

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allowance, a limit
a chest is a box

explanation.surface: Cricket scoring: going over the limit, around the box, to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestration is the arranging of music for instruments, and scoring a piece is exactly that.

clue.text: Queen's bishop accepting orthodox opening that's wrong

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

indicators.note: the bishop's letters accept, i.e. take in, the next piece

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

indicators.note: the opening of orthodox means just its first letter

explanation.surface: A chess opening: the queen's bishop moves in an orthodox line that turns out to be a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen's bishop' is chess talk, but here it is ER plus RR (Right Reverend).
explanation.definitionFit: A wrong, as a noun, is a mistake or misdeed, which is what a slip or blunder is.

clue.text: Horrific writer with shocking thing about Tay originally

definitions.text: Horrific writer with shocking thing about Tay originally

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, author of horror tales

indicators.note: the stun gun's letters go about, i.e. around, the next piece

parts.note: a Taser is a stun gun that gives an electric shock

indicators.note: originally means take only the first letter of Tay

explanation.surface: A dreadful writer with a shocking piece about the River Tay.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: William McGonagall, often called the worst poet in English, wrote 'The Tay Bridge Disaster'. The Tay is a Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetaster is an inferior versifier, and the clue paints the most famous one, writing horribly about a shocking event on the Tay.

clue.text: Tarnish can, in devices, start to spoil

indicators.note: the can goes in the devices

parts.note: ruses are tricks or devices
a tin is a can

indicators.note: start to spoil means its first letter

explanation.surface: Tarnish on a can, inside some machinery, starts to spoil it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarnish as a noun is the dull corroded state of metal, which is what a coat of oxidation gives.

clue.text: Circumference not grand for male amusement

indicators.note: not grand, so the grand letter is dropped from the measurement
male comes in for the dropped letter, replacing it

parts.note: girth is the measurement round something
G is short for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A waistline measurement taken without a grand, giving a man a laugh.
explanation.definitionFit: Mirth is laughter and merriment, a synonym for amusement.

clue.text: 'Citizen Kane' with Welles finally in character

indicators.note: the last letter goes in the character word

parts.note: heart can mean someone's essential nature or character

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of Welles

explanation.surface: Orson Welles finally getting into character as Citizen Kane.
explanation.walkthrough: Welles's film 'Citizen Kane' was modelled on the newspaper magnate William Randolph Hearst.
explanation.definitionFit: The title character of the film is widely taken as a portrait of press baron William Randolph Hearst.

clue.text: Trickery of Smart Alec if I trade up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters read from bottom to top
of means the letters are taken from within the words

explanation.surface: A smart alec's trickery if he trades up.
explanation.definitionFit: Artifice is clever deceit or cunning, so trickery.

clue.text: Footballers' partners embracing team leader upset birds

indicators.note: the partners embrace, holding inside, the following pieces

parts.note: WAGs, wives and girlfriends, is a British tabloid label for footballers' partners

indicators.note: the team leader is its first letter

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or upset

explanation.surface: Footballers' wives and girlfriends hug the team captain, who is upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagtails are small songbirds known for constantly bobbing their tails.

clue.text: Raised Japanese group almost employing special force ninja

indicators.note: the turned word employs, taking inside, the special force
in a down clue raised means read upwards
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Nissan is a Japanese car group
the SAS is the British Special Air Service

explanation.surface: A Japanese company almost hires special forces to train a ninja.
explanation.definitionFit: A ninja was a Japanese mercenary spy, trained in covert killing, so a hired killer.

clue.text: Sleuth ace retained by Bill to find wallet

indicators.note: retained by means held inside the bill word

parts.note: a bill is a bird's beak, a nose
tec is short for detective
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A detective's ace is kept by Bill, who goes looking for a wallet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a name or a banknote, but it is a beak.
explanation.definitionFit: A notecase is an old word for a wallet, a pocket holder for banknotes.

clue.text: Circular form produced by 'Little Boy'?

parts.note: a chap is a boy or fellow
-let is a suffix meaning little, as in piglet

explanation.surface: Something round made by the 'Little Boy' atomic bomb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little Boy' was the Hiroshima bomb, suggesting a mushroom cloud; here it is the pieces in reverse order.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplet is a wreath or garland worn on the head, or a string of beads, both a ring shape.

clue.text: Person eliciting great interest?

parts.note: seems to describe someone fascinating, but the interest is money charged on a loan, at an excessive rate

explanation.surface: Someone who draws a lot of attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Interest' is the charge on borrowed money, not curiosity.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender who charges exorbitant rates on loans demands great interest in the financial sense.

clue.text: Lawman shoots up fellow grabbing hostage's head

indicators.note: these pieces grab, holding inside, the next letter
in a down clue up means read bottom to top

parts.note: fires means shoots

indicators.note: the head of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A lawman fires on a man who has grabbed a hostage.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheriff is a law-enforcement officer of a US county.

clue.text: Reportedly, which people perform witchcraft?

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard rather than spelt

parts.note: said as a question, which people perform becomes who do

explanation.surface: A question about who carries out witchcraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoodoo is African-American folk magic, a form of sorcery or voodoo.

clue.text: 'Below' isn't formal, oddly

indicators.note: oddly means take the first, third, fifth letters and so on

explanation.surface: A grammar note: the word 'below' isn't formal, oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: Infra is Latin for underneath, used in writing to point the reader further down.

clue.text: Last word about sound, time for 'Satisfaction'

indicators.note: the prayer ending goes about, around, the sound

parts.note: amen is the word that ends a prayer
a tone is a sound

explanation.surface: A last word on a sound recording, time for the song 'Satisfaction'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Satisfaction' suggests the Rolling Stones song but means making amends.
explanation.definitionFit: Satisfaction in the old sense is reparation for a wrong, the same idea as making amends for sin.

clue.text: Tests intimacy in the morning, head to toe

indicators.note: the head letter moves to the toe, the end

parts.note: sex is intimacy
AM is the abbreviation for the morning

explanation.surface: Morning intimacy, head to toe, as a test.
explanation.definitionFit: Exams are examinations, formal tests of knowledge.

clue.text: Restricted diet instead missing even elements

parts.note: a lo-cal diet is a low-calorie one

indicators.note: drop the second, fourth and sixth letters, keeping the odd ones

explanation.surface: A restricted diet replaced by one with elements missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something localised is confined or kept to one area, so restricted in extent.

clue.text: The compiler had a house somewhere in the USA

parts.note: the setter speaking of themself says I'd, I had

explanation.surface: The setter once owned a house somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is a north-western state of America, so a place there.

clue.text: Raise one's hand initially after small whip's withdrawn

indicators.note: after puts the raising pieces behind the small whip

parts.note: to tan is to beat or whip
to doff is to raise or take off one's hat
one is, written as I plus S

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of hand

explanation.surface: A shy person raises a hand after a little whip is taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aloof and reserved keeps others at a distance, which is what withdrawn describes.
